acceptanceCriteria.text: Production assignment creates/uses a Tsukai AgentRun rather than directly owning a Pi AgentSession lifecycle.
Lifecycle observation and event/replay consumption flow from Tsukai.
Cancellation flows through Tsukai scoped AgentRun control.
Stored agentRunId is used for restart/reconnect reconciliation before any create.
Restart/reconnect does not duplicate an already-established AgentRun.
Retry creates a distinct AgentRun while retaining Mottainai orchestration correlation.
Manager projections preserve explicit gaps, uncertainty, provenance, and unavailable metrics.
Jinushi remains the physical process owner.
Existing Manager API behavior is covered by focused regression tests after cutover.

issue.title: impl: cut Manager execution and observation over to Tsukai
